content.text: No minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume floor exists in this agreement. Fees operate as a revenue share on actual auction activity (§5), and §1 expressly disclaims exclusivity and preserves AP's right to sell Inventory through other channels.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The rule seeks the absence of minimum purchase commitments or volume restrictions on the Customer. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "volume" and "exclusive" surface no take-or-pay or spend floor binding AP. The only "minimum" references are the Winning Bid Price floor that AP itself sets (p0014) and Kubient's disclaimer that no minimum revenue is guaranteed (p0062) — neither imposes a purchase obligation on us. Fees under §5 (p0023) are a revenue share on actual activity generated through the Auction Platform, with no committed spend or usage, and §1 (p0001) expressly negates exclusivity and preserves AP's right to sell Inventory elsewhere. The one-year initial term lock in §4(a) restricts termination timing but creates no purchase or volume commitment, so it is outside this rule. Position satisfied at the preferred level; no redline needed.
